authenticity.a: Every pair is inspected point by point by our experts before dispatch. We guarantee 100% authenticity on all our products, with an authentication certificate included. No replicas, no doubt.

shipping.a: Tracked delivery 24/7 across Tunisia. Parcels within 24-48 business hours in Tunis and the greater Tunis area, 2-4 business days elsewhere in the country. International shipping available on request. A tracking number is emailed as soon as your order ships.

returns.a: 14 days to change your mind. Free returns in Tunisia. The pair must be returned in its original condition, with all tags and the box. Refunded within 72 hours of receiving the return.

sizing.a: Every size from EU 39 to 47 is in stock. Check our size guide to find your exact size. If you are torn between two sizes, we recommend going with the larger one.

payment.a: 100% secure payment. We accept card payments, Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and 3x interest-free payments via Alma. Your bank details are encrypted and we never store any payment information.

about.title: The Journal
about.lead: The story of the district, our sources, our obsessions.
about.intro: Q2M started in a back room with three boxes and a single rule — never sell what we would not wear ourselves. Today we move limited pairs for people who treat the shoe as the last build they will ever wear.
about.pillar1Body: Every piece is inspected, weighed and registered before it reaches the vault. Never a replica.
about.pillar2Body: We buy allocations, not leftovers. Members see new colourways before anyone else.
about.pillar3Body: Tracked priority delivery in 40+ countries with a 48 h window on every order.
about.pillar4Body: Deadstock is put back in circulation instead of buried. Trade-ins credit your next pair.
about.metaDescription: The story of the district, our sources, our obsessions. Sneakers curated in Paris.
